scope: COV-019q: complete the existing quoted-command ending combinations of restricted request auxiliary 달다. Twelve existing canonical endings become available after 어 달다; no new ending family or label is introduced.
restrictions: The immediately following ending is a single reviewed request/quoted-command form. Past, modal, retrospective and honorific prefinals on the auxiliary remain outside the restricted paradigm.
Factual 라-family endings are not substituted for command 으라 forms. Ordinary lexical 달다 homonyms remain distinct.
Existing outer-particle rules operate after the completed request group; internal-particle and connector licenses are unchanged.

The primary auxiliary entry and three 아/어/여 달다 expression entries have every example represented. Corroborating excerpts are distinguished from inferred combinations, notably 달랍니다 and 달라지만, which compose the auxiliary with independently sourced command-ending rules.
The literal requests, contracted reports and dictionary senses are morphological alternatives; no implicit reporting 하다 or speaker/sense interpretation is inserted.

corpus.selection: All joined training tokens whose aligned morphology has 달 with px/VX after at least two components, in the pinned KAIST and GSD training partitions. None uses one of the newly enabled report endings. Complete sentences and original annotations are retained.

annotation_disagreements.interpretation: The context describes hanging/tethering to a cart. The source annotation treats 달 as an auxiliary, whereas the dictionary-backed compound 매달다 is retained separately. Request 달다 is not given unrestricted adnominal 은 to satisfy this token.
The sentence names Nadal entering a slump. The morphology annotation disagrees with that nominal context; it remains unmodified and unmatched. No request auxiliary rule is inferred from it.

remaining: COV-017at tracks the distinct unimplemented short-report family: 도와달래 needs command-report 으래, which is not licensed by this ending-composition repair.
Other left-class/lexical/semantic restrictions, additional internal particles and auxiliaries remain under COV-019.
Cross-token parsing, contextual sense ranking and general spacing repair remain deferred.
Independent Korean-language review and linguistic precision estimation remain pending.
